channel.title: The Local Europe - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local Europe (thelocal.com)

item.title: Pollution exposure in Europe linked to mental health problems
item.description: Environmental pollution is linked to several mental health disorders in Europe, the European Environment Agency (EEA) has warned, arguing that enforcing legislation would result in Europeans being both less depressed and less anxious.

item.title: Sweden Democrat leader calls for freeze on teen deportations
item.description: Sweden Democrat leader Jimmie Åkesson has called for the country’s controversial ‘teen deportations’ to be suspended with immediate effect until a solution has been found.

item.title: No, the Pompidou Centre isn't being turned into migrant housing
item.description: The French cybercrime authorities are investigating after the website of a Paris mayoral election candidate was spoofed, and false claims published that he intended to turn the Pompidou Centre into 'housing for migrants'.

item.title: OPINION: Why Macron will not 'do a Chirac' over this Gulf war
item.description: As the US launches strikes against Iran, Emmanuel Macron's reaction has been very different to his predecessor Jacques Chirac, who refused to join the British and American invasion of Iraq in 2003 - John Lichfield examines why.

item.title: EES LATEST: The key dates when France will enforce new EU border checks
item.description: The EU's new Entry & Exit System of border control started on October 12th - but a phased introduction means that not everyone travelling to and from France is affected by the new system.

item.title: How the CDU aims to tighten Germany's citizenship rules in 2026
item.description: Conservative lawmakers in Germany have had their sights set on tightening the country's citizenship law since it was reformed in 2024. Here's how the party wants to make it harder for foreign residents to get a German passport this year.

item.title: Inside France: Middle East, Municipal elections and cross-Channel sporting banter
item.description: From the ghost of Jacques Chirac to the local election hustings, via a bit of Communist history and some cross-Channel banter, Inside France is our weekly look at the latest news and talking points from France.

item.title: Which countries in Europe impose language tests for residency permits?
item.description: Certain countries across Europe demand foreign citizens pass a language test to qualify for certain residency permits. But how does each country compare and what level of language do they require?

item.title: Inside Spain: Sánchez didn’t kill the 'British expat dream', Brexit did
item.description: In this week's edition we look at how recent articles in the British press claiming Spain is directly targeting UK retirees and dashing their hopes of owning a Spanish holiday home have failed to focus on the elephant in the room.

item.title: Oslo police probe possible terror motive after US embassy blast
item.description: An explosion that rocked the US embassy in Oslo in the early hours of Sunday may have been an act of terror, local police said, while stressing that they were also investigating other possible causes.
